value.rationale: A current quantitative modeling question is whether more identical gradually moving intervention sources necessarily improve adoption. The theorem answers it on a fully specified nontrivial fixed ordinary network with a sharp K=2 versus K=3 cliff and a large exact 31/50 mean loss, explaining the irreversible edge rupture analytically. This separates an important structural mechanism from the qualitative preexisting observation of early opinion segregation and from models with repulsion or changing regular-agent edges.
